purpose: Join only privacy-safe public projections of the two remaining physical launch gates before the final #162 one-compatible-view gauntlet.

owner44.privacy: Strict public projection only. Private repository identities, private exact pins, sensitive local paths and private-history digests are not accepted fields.

nas164.claim_rule: Reference CI cannot satisfy this input.

same_view_binding.rule: Both public projections must bind to the exact same expected Genesis and Swarm main SHAs. Any drift fails closed.

authentication_rule: READY_FOR_FINAL_162_GAUNTLET is forbidden until exact public projection digests and underlying execution-evidence digests from real owner44 and NAS164 runs are pinned here in source control. The CLI exposes no trust-binding override.

output.next_step: After both real runs, pin their projection/evidence digests in this protocol, review that commit, then run the authenticated join and the final closed-loop #162 gauntlet on one frozen compatible view.
